svg.title: gpushare in nvsnap: From Admission to a Restored Pod
svg.desc: At admission the nvsnap webhook gives every GPU container of a pod nvsnap may capture the gpushare library, the node bundle and a per-pod chunk store. At capture, the agent on the pod's node runs nvsnap-gpu-suspend suspend and stop in the pod, dumps it with CRIU and moves the chunk store into the checkpoint. A later pod of the same configuration becomes a placeholder; the agent on its node gets the checkpoint, restores it with CRIU and resumes the GPU processes on the placeholder's GPUs.

to LD_PRELOAD, and a per-pod directory of the node's checkpoint disk at /nvsnap-gpushare. An engine that spans pods also gets NVSNAP_GPUSHARE_FABRIC=1. A pod whose configuration has a usable
Once the pod is Ready, its node's agent runs nvsnap-gpu-suspend gpus, suspend and stop inside the pod, and 6 dumps it with CRIU without the CUDA plugin; the chunk store moves into the
The restore node's agent uses its own copy, or fetches one from cluster storage or a peer agent. 8 It restores the processes with CRIU and 9 resumes them on the placeholder's GPUs (--gpu-map).
